name: Ahlen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the top with the city arms of Ahlen (an eel below a crenellated wall on white).
history: Municipal flag of Ahlen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ahlen arms — eel and wall on white
